title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m in
You know who I think is hott
Sara Barellis
Nah, I’m not a fan of her
Disliked “Nah, I’m not a fan of her”
Do you think Michele is really obsessed with her husband
Zack Van Gonedy
I’m just pleased with my team name. A good first step. When is draft order
Wait, I don’t get the joke about Michele’s husband. Isn’t his last name kroll
I don’t know I thought it was Van something. I picked Gonedy
Draft order is randomized one order before draft. I want a computer to randomize it.
She said in an IG post she was obsessed with him
I just think that’s strong
That’s good
Yeah, well they’re married so I suppose that’s OK
I think it’s bullshit, that’s what I think!
Tell her that!
Jk
Don’t do that
Lol
“Michele, just clarifying: Are you really obsessed with Zack? Like, really?”
Laughed at ““Michele, just clarifying: Are you really obsessed with Zack? Like, really?””
Did Mikaela’s grandpa die or something
Profile pic
Her grandpa or grandma died last summer (I forget which one). Not sure why she changed it to that. I know her and Shane were not doing so hot
Oh ok
Do you get messenger in Malta?
Yeah I just re added it
Ok, whatever you do at the moment, don’t chime in the group chat. I may have just explained to Mikaela that I was frustrated that I had had feelings for her and it’s a bit awkward.
I won’t. Don’t be a dumbass
I did message her though saying I was frustrated with her green-ass texts
What did you say?
I mean, look, you’re not being a dumbass. I don’t want that to come off wrong. But I feel like you gotta have a good element of timing with this
I’ve been holding off on that for awhile and when she started saying she had a crush on another guy I just decided I wasn’t going to listen to more of that. I can’t go through hearing that shit.
Yeah I know.... I guess from the little I’ve spoken with her about them, my guess is I don’t think it’s going to work
So I was coming from the perspective of ... patience, because that’s what I see happening. But I didn’t know that
Oh believe me, I was practicing patience and waiting for them to break up. But figured if I allowed that other thought to go further I’d be fucked
I don’t see anything wrong with that
Oh well, more than likely this ends in the status quo.
How did you say it

Just that I’ll always be her friend and support, but going forward I don’t want to talk about a guy with whom you “haven’t had feelings like that before” because I had feelings (and probably still do) for you.
I think that’s fine. I’d just try to keep it status quo like it didn’t happen. As a friend, she’s prob gonna need that because now she’s really confused in the head, if I had to guess
Exactly. That’s what I was planning.
How’s Malta? Warmer?
Yeah it’s nice. I’m burnt as F
